content.heading: What is Restaurant SEO?
body: Restaurant SEO is how you get your restaurant to the top of Google search results.
When someone searches "chicken and waffles in Chicago," good restaurant SEO helps convince Google that your website should be at the top of the search rankings.

When done right, your restaurant website shows up first when locals search for nearby food or restaurants. Restaurant websites with strong SEO get more visibility, which drives more traffic and more sales — both offline and online. If you take online reservations, you’ll get more bookings; if you offer online ordering , you’ll see more direct online sales.

content.heading: Do All Restaurants Need SEO?
body: Some restaurants need more SEO than others. Let’s say your restaurant does a lot of takeout. This makes SEO essential because likely thousands of people in your area are searching for food online.
For many restaurants, SEO is the most effective way to attract new customers . Social media like Instagram or Facebook may get attention, but the real revenue comes from search.

Here’s data from a restaurant using Owner.com showing where their new customers come from—a breakdown typical across most of our clients. Notice how Google drives far more traffic than any social platform.

content.heading: How Google Ranks Restaurants in Search Results
body: Google decides which restaurants to rank (and in what order) based on three core factors: relevance, distance and prominence. Relevance is how well your restaurant website matches what someone is searching for.
Distance is how close your restaurant is to where the searcher (or the location they name) is.
Prominence is how well-known and trusted your restaurant is, built from your volume and quality of reviews, mentioned and links across the web.

content.heading: How to do SEO for Restaurants (Step-by-Step Guide)
body: You don't need to be an online marketing genius or SEO expert to get your restaurant website to rank well and drive traffic from customers. All you need is this handy guide which breaks it all down for you and the right tools. Let's dive in.

There are hundreds of SEO tools on the market that can help you understand your SEO rankings, traffic and competitors when it comes to SEO. Most of them are expensive and complicated, so that's why we built our Restaurant Website Grader , a free tool that leverages AI to analyze your restaurant website's SEO keywords and compare it against your competitors. Not only that, but the tool also helps provide you with actionable recommendations to improve your restaurant SEO – all for free and ready within 2 minutes.

Keyword research for restaurants involves figuring out the exact words diners type into Google when they're looking for a restaurant like yours. These are the terms that people type into Google that relate to your food and location.
